home: The Gordon Smith Gallery of Canadian Art is a public art gallery at 2121 Lonsdale Avenue, North Vancouver, and the home of Artists for Kids. Exhibitions, programs and limited edition prints. Admission is by donation.

about-us.description: The Gordon Smith Gallery of Canadian Art in North Vancouver is home to Artists for Kids and the Gordon and Marion Smith Foundation: exhibitions, programs and art education.

after-school-art.description: After School Art classes for students each fall, winter and spring term, led by BC certified art specialist teachers. All art materials are included.

art-in-good-company.description: A drop-in program for seniors at the Gordon Smith Gallery: chat about and make art inspired by the current exhibition. Second Thursday of every month, 2:30 to 4 PM.

artists.description: The Canadian artists in the permanent collection of Artists for Kids and the Gordon Smith Gallery, A to Z, with the works the collection holds by each.

artists-for-kids.description: Artists for Kids, established in 1989, offers art education for children and youth in North Vancouver: classes, camps, school programs and the Gordon Smith Gallery of Canadian Art.

artists-in-residence.description: Students nominated by their teachers work for full days with a professional artist at the Artists for Kids studios, from ceramics and painting to collage and photography.

artreach-videos.description: ArtReach videos from Artists for Kids guide classrooms and people at home through art activities, with lessons from Kindergarten to Grade 12.

awards-and-scholarships.description: Artists for Kids offers three scholarships to North Vancouver School District graduating students in Grade 12 visual and performing arts courses.

brilliance-gala.description: The Brilliance Gala supports art education for children and youth across the Lower Mainland through Artists for Kids, led by artists and educators.

classes-and-camps.description: After School Art classes, spring and summer day camps and the Paradise Valley summer camp for young artists, from Artists for Kids in North Vancouver.

contact.description: Contact the Gordon Smith Gallery and Artists for Kids: 2121 Lonsdale Avenue, North Vancouver, BC V7M 2K6. Telephone (604) 903-3798.

current-events.description: What is on this week at the Gordon Smith Gallery in North Vancouver: talks, concerts, workshops and drop-in art programs.

day-camps.description: Week-long spring and summer day camps with Artists for Kids: drawing, painting and printmaking taught in small groups by BC certified art specialist teachers.

donate.description: Give to the Gordon and Marion Smith Foundation for Young Artists. Your gift supports exhibitions, school programs, family art-making days, camps, bursaries and scholarships.

explore-create.description: A free drop-in art program for families with children ages 5 to 12, Saturdays from 1 to 3 PM at the Gordon Smith Gallery. Donations are welcome.

frequently-asked-questions.description: Answers about buying limited edition prints from Artists for Kids: editions, payment, shipping, framed prints and pickup.

gallery-program.description: Grade 5 classes study the current exhibition in the gallery, then make art in the studio, taught by their classroom teacher and an art teacher from Artists for Kids.

gordon-and-marion.description: Gordon Smith (1919 to 2020), a cornerstone of Modernist painting in Canada, and Marion Smith, and the belief in art education that grounds the foundation in their name.

learning-guides.description: Learning guides to download from Artists for Kids: art lessons for the classroom, created with artists.

learning-kits.description: Teachers in the North Vancouver School District can book clay and collagraph kits from Artists for Kids for two weeks, with tools, lesson plans and step-by-step instructions.

music-at-the-smith.description: A seasonal concert series at the Gordon Smith Gallery: jazz, folk, indie, classical and world music, performed alongside the current exhibition.

on-now.description: The exhibition on now at the Gordon Smith Gallery of Canadian Art, 2121 Lonsdale Avenue, North Vancouver. Admission is by donation.

paradise-valley-summer-camp.description: A summer art camp in Paradise Valley for young artists ages 9 to 15, five days and four nights: collage, drawing, painting and printmaking, with outdoor recreation.

past-events.description: Past talks, concerts, workshops and drop-in art programs at the Gordon Smith Gallery in North Vancouver, newest first.

past-exhibitions.description: Past exhibitions at the Gordon Smith Gallery of Canadian Art in North Vancouver, newest first, with their dates and curators.

permanent-collection.description: Search and browse more than 1,000 works by Canadian artists in the permanent collection of Artists for Kids and the Gordon Smith Gallery.

plan-your-visit.description: The Gordon Smith Gallery is at 2121 Lonsdale Avenue, North Vancouver. Open Thursday to Saturday, 12 to 4 PM. Admission is by donation. Wheelchair accessible.

professional-development.description: Professional development workshops from Artists for Kids for Kindergarten to Grade 12 educators: learning through the visual arts.

public-programs-1.description: Talks, workshops, family days, seniors programs, concerts and exhibition tours at the Gordon Smith Gallery in North Vancouver.

schools-and-teachers.description: School programs and teaching resources from Artists for Kids: the Gallery Program, Artists in Residence, learning guides and kits, ArtReach videos and professional development.

shop.description: Limited edition prints by Canadian artists, published by Artists for Kids since 1990. Sales fund art education programs for children and youth.

smith-foundation-scholarships.description: The Gordon and Marion Smith Foundation offers scholarships to three graduating Grade 12 students from North Vancouver, West Vancouver and Vancouver.

smith-foundation-supporters.description: The donors, sponsors, grant agencies and foundations that support the Gordon and Marion Smith Foundation for Young Artists.

speaker-series.description: Talks at the Gordon Smith Gallery: exhibition panels, conversations with curators and artists, and insights from designers and architects.

studio-art-academy.description: The Artists for Kids Studio Art Academy: hands-on learning with professional artists and a personal portfolio. Not offered for the 2026/2027 school year.

support-artists-for-kids.description: Artists for Kids is a not-for-profit art education program of the North Vancouver School District. Your gift supports programs in schools and the community, and scholarships.

the-smith-foundation.description: The Gordon and Marion Smith Foundation for Young Artists, founded in 2002, funds visual arts programs for children and presents programs and exhibitions at the Gordon Smith Gallery.

upcoming-events.description: Upcoming talks, concerts, workshops and drop-in art programs at the Gordon Smith Gallery in North Vancouver.

upcoming-exhibitions.description: Exhibitions opening soon at the Gordon Smith Gallery of Canadian Art in North Vancouver.

volunteer.description: Volunteer at the Gordon Smith Gallery as a gallery attendant or an event assistant. Download the form to apply.
